clean.root_cause: The agent did not locate the soapbar, as it was not on the initial countertop and the agent's search of handtowelholder, towelholder, and cabinets did not find it.
clean.evidence: At countertop 1, observed only toiletpaper 1; subsequent searches found no soapbar.
clean.corrective_rule: If the target object is not on the initial countertop, systematically search all common receptacles (sinkbasin, drawers, cabinets) before revisiting locations.
clean.skill_tree_gap: Missing a systematic search strategy for objects not immediately visible on the starting surface.

cool.root_cause: The agent never found a pan, as it visited many locations but missed countertop 3 or drawers where the pan might be.
cool.evidence: Observations at countertop 2, diningtable, sinkbasin, stoveburners, fridge, cabinet 1 showed no pan.
cool.corrective_rule: When the target object is not in the first few locations, expand search to all countertops, drawers, and cabinets systematically.
cool.skill_tree_gap: Lack of exhaustive search procedure for locating the target object.

heat.root_cause: The agent saw a plate on countertop 1 but did not take it, instead exploring cabinets without picking up the target.
heat.evidence: At countertop 1, observed 'plate 1' among items, but next action was 'go to countertop 2'.
heat.corrective_rule: When the target object is visible on a surface, immediately take it before exploring other locations.
heat.skill_tree_gap: Lack of a rule to prioritize picking up the target object when observed.

look_at_obj_in_light.root_cause: The agent never found the newspaper; it only opened a few drawers and did not search shelves or other surfaces.
look_at_obj_in_light.evidence: No newspaper appeared in any observation after searching coffeetable, drawers, and back to coffeetable.
look_at_obj_in_light.corrective_rule: If the target object is not in the initial view, search all receptacles and surfaces (drawers, shelves, furniture) systematically.
look_at_obj_in_light.skill_tree_gap: Lack of a broad search strategy for finding an object not in immediate room description.

look_at_obj_in_light.root_cause: The agent never found the book; it searched shelves and one drawer but missed other locations like the desk or dresser.
look_at_obj_in_light.evidence: Observations showed no book after searching shelves 1-7 and drawer 1.
look_at_obj_in_light.corrective_rule: Search all furniture surfaces (dresser, desk, sidetable) as well as shelves and drawers for the target object.
look_at_obj_in_light.skill_tree_gap: Incomplete search strategy that does not cover all possible object locations.

look_at_obj_in_light.root_cause: The agent never found the laptop; it searched diningtable, drawers, and sidetable but missed the armchair and other surfaces.

look_at_obj_in_light.corrective_rule: Expand search to all furniture including armchairs, sofas, and shelves to locate the object.

look_at_obj_in_light.root_cause: The agent never found the laptop; it searched desk, dresser, shelves but repeatedly returned to desk without finding it.
look_at_obj_in_light.evidence: No laptop observed; agent looped between desk and dresser without new findings.
look_at_obj_in_light.corrective_rule: If the target object is not in the first few locations, systematically list all unexplored receptacles and visit each.
look_at_obj_in_light.skill_tree_gap: No mechanism to track which locations have been searched and which are still unvisited.

pick_and_place.root_cause: The agent never found the spraybottle; it searched sinkbasin, handtowelholders, drawers, bathtubbasin but missed other receptacles like cabinets.
pick_and_place.evidence: No spraybottle observed in any visited location.
pick_and_place.corrective_rule: When searching for an object, check all receptacles including cabinets, shelves, and countertops.
pick_and_place.skill_tree_gap: Search pattern limited to bathroom-related receptacles; missing kitchen cabinets.

pick_and_place.root_cause: The agent never found a peppershaker; it searched countertop2, diningtable, sinkbasin, cabinets 1-4 but no peppershaker present.
pick_and_place.evidence: No peppershaker observed in any of the visited locations.
pick_and_place.corrective_rule: If the target object is not in the common areas, check all remaining cabinets, drawers, and shelves.
pick_and_place.skill_tree_gap: Incomplete exploration of all possible container objects.

pick_two_obj_and_place.root_cause: The agent picked up a cup from countertop1 but did not place it in a cabinet and did not search for a second cup.
pick_two_obj_and_place.evidence: After taking cup1, next action was 'go to cabinet 8' without a placement action, and trajectory ends.
pick_two_obj_and_place.corrective_rule: After picking an object, immediately go to the target receptacle and place it before searching for the second object.
pick_two_obj_and_place.skill_tree_gap: Missing a step to place the picked object right after acquiring it.

pick_two_obj_and_place.root_cause: The agent never found any remotecontrol; it only searched cabinets and missed drawers, shelves, and furniture surfaces.
pick_two_obj_and_place.evidence: No remotecontrol observed after opening cabinets 4-8.
pick_two_obj_and_place.corrective_rule: Search all receptacles including drawers, shelves, and furniture surfaces for the target object.
pick_two_obj_and_place.skill_tree_gap: Search strategy limited to cabinets; missing other common locations.

pick_two_obj_and_place.root_cause: The agent found and placed one box, but then failed to find a second box, wandering to armchairs repeatedly.
pick_two_obj_and_place.evidence: After placing box2, agent visited armchair1 and armchair2 but found no second box; never searched other locations.
pick_two_obj_and_place.corrective_rule: After placing the first object, systematically search all remaining receptacles (drawers, shelves, other furniture) for the second object.
pick_two_obj_and_place.skill_tree_gap: No systematic post-placement search strategy for the second object.

pick_two_obj_and_place.root_cause: The agent found and placed one cellphone, then got stuck in a loop between armchair and coffeetable, never searching for a second cellphone.
pick_two_obj_and_place.evidence: After placing cellphone1, agent looped between armchair1 and coffeetable1 without new object discoveries.
pick_two_obj_and_place.corrective_rule: If the second object is not in the first location, expand search to other unreached locations rather than looping.
pick_two_obj_and_place.skill_tree_gap: Lack of exploration diversity after placing the first object.

pick_two_obj_and_place.root_cause: The agent never found any newspaper; it searched a few drawers and tables but missed shelves and other surfaces.
